prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Select a pet companion to watch their personality traits live on your screen.", "Interactive Mascot Preview"]
1: ["What behavior best fits your desktop?", "Answer 2 quick questions so your pet adapts to your work style.", "Playful vs Calm Behavior", "Continue to Customization"]
2: ["Your Pet is Getting Ready!", "Play a quick reaction mini-game while we set up your pet's desktop home.", "Desktop Pet Mini Game"]
3: []
4: ["Signing in with an existing account automatically restores all saved pets and adoption history.", "Automatic Cloud Restoration Active"]
5: ["Verifying desktop display compatibility and screen layer permissions...", "Display Overlays Verified"]
6: ["Confirm Adoption Details", "Review your desktop pet summary and sign the official certificate.", "Your pet will be saved to your account upon signing."]
7: ["Your Pet is Live! Here is How to Interact", "Right-click the system tray icon to hide or customize. Click your pet anytime to talk or play!", "Start Playing"]
8: ["Play Chime When Pet Appears"]
9: ["Claim Your Free Welcome Gift!", "Finish this 30-second introduction to unlock an exclusive starter toy for your pet.", "Gift item will automatically be added to your pet's desktop inventory.", "Exclusive Welcome Toy Unlocked"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free gifts and exclusive extras
